content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Amarillo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and documented work experience in project leadership roles. PMI sets specific thresholds; Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you confirm qualification before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all required formal education sessions delivered by experienced instructors. This PMI-mandated training covers the PMBOK Guide framework and exam domains essential for Amarillo professionals in energy, agriculture, and construction sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your official PMP application directly with PMI and pay the associated examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation and submission. PMI reviews your eligibility claim; once approved, you receive authorization to schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your computer-based exam at a local or regional testing center. On exam day, demonstrate mastery of project-management practices across all PMBOK domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) during your three-year certification cycle through training, conferences, and project work. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting proof of PDU completion to PMI. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education options to help you stay current and advance your career.
